title: nextflow-clinical-ngs samplesheet schema
description: Schema for validating clinical NGS samplesheet CSV input across germline, tumor_normal, and tumor_only analysis modes.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the sequencing library/sample.

patient_id.description: Biological patient identifier used to pair tumor and normal samples.

pair_id.description: Optional explicit analysis pairing ID when a patient has multiple tumor samples.

analysis.description: Target variant calling branch for this sample.

fastq_1.description: Path to Read 1 gzipped FASTQ file.

fastq_2.description: Path to Read 2 gzipped FASTQ file.
